From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Redwood evaluation - procurement & security next steps

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary from the call:
- Use case: internal assistant for customer success to summarize calls and surface KB articles.
- Expected QPS / throughput: pilot < 10k tokens/day, production estimate 50–100k tokens/day.
- Key gating items: procurement paperwork (PO vs card), SOC 2 Type II evidence, DPA, and completion of your security questionnaire.

Open questions / asks for your procurement team:
1) Commercial path: do you typically onboard via PO (net-30/60) or will you use corporate card for initial pilots? Any marketplace preference (AWS Marketplace, GCP Marketplace) to simplify billing?
2) Procurement contacts and vendor onboarding steps — can you share the onboarding checklist or contact?
3) Security: are SOC 2 Type II report and a standard DPA sufficient, or do you need a completed security questionnaire first?

Attachments: I'm attaching a short SOC2 summary and our DPA template for your legal/security review. Rishi (cc'd) will follow up on technical security questions.

Proposed next steps:
- Procurement intro: if you share the right contact, I'll loop in our finance team and send any requested forms.
- Security: Rishi to answer questionnaire specifics.
- Commercial: I'll send an overview of pricing / PO vs card flow and a marketplace FAQ.

Would love to schedule a quick 30-min procurement + security alignment next week with your procurement lead if that works.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation - procurement & security next steps

Hi Marissa — great meeting, thanks. Quick answers below:

- Commercial/billing: For enterprise purchases above $25k we prefer PO with net-30. For pilots <$5k we often use corporate card. For longer-term ease we'd favor AWS Marketplace if you support it, but it's not a blocker.
- Procurement contact: please loop in procurement@acme.com (cc'd) — they'll send vendor onboarding steps.
- Security gating: Security will want SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA before production. They may ask you to complete a short vendor security questionnaire (we'll share).

I'll coordinate internally and get the questionnaire over. For timeline, procurement can move within 2–3 weeks after legal sign-off depending on PO cycles.

Thanks —
Jordan
Sr. PM, Platform
Acme Corp

Thanks for sharing the questionnaire, team. I pulled a few quick answers and clarifications below (happy to expand in the meeting).

- Data residency: Redwood offers region-specific hosting; for Acme we can pin workloads to us-west-2.
- SOC 2: we're SOC 2 Type II compliant; attaching a summary here and will share the cert under NDA.
- Encryption: data in transit TLS1.2+; at rest AES-256 with customer key options via KMS.
- Access controls: RBAC + SSO (SAML / OIDC) supported; audit logs available via the Console.
- DPA: our standard DPA covers data processing and subprocessors; legal can redline if needed.

If there are questionnaire items that need formal answers, point them to me and I'll produce doc-ready responses. I can also join the call Thu at 10 PT.

-Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Perfect, thanks Rishi and Marissa. Thu 10 PT works for procurement & security. A couple of quick items to prepare: 
- Procurement will need a vendor setup form + W9 (please have finance team ready).
- Legal wants to review the DPA draft; we may request a few minor redlines.
- Marketplace: procurement's preference is AWS Marketplace to avoid vendor setup overhead. Can you confirm whether Redwood is already on AWS Marketplace or if that's a multi-week process? If marketplace is not immediately available we can proceed with PO + Docusign.

See you on the call.

Jordan
